turns.text: Hi. The print was delivered to the old flat. I'd like to change the delivery address on that order now.
I’m sorry the print went to your old flat. Could you send me the order number and the email address you used at checkout? I’ll check what options are available.
Order SC-5209, email cressida.paunelu@example.com. The new delivery address would be Lindenweg 9, Graz.

I’m sorry the print went to your old flat. The delivery address can only be changed before shipping, so I haven’t changed it. I’ve handed this over to a colleague who will take over and check what options are available.

rule.ro: Adresa de livrare se poate schimba până la expedierea comenzii. Schimbarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: The delivery address can change until the order ships. Staff must approve the change.

input.summary: Verified customer cressida.paunelu@example.com reports print delivered to old flat and wants address changed to Lindenweg 9, Graz. Policy disallows address changes after shipment. Please review what options are available; no change filed.
